title: Google Pixel: attackers can gain admin rights
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 53 days old, so many systems are likely still unpatched.

category.label: Computers, phones and browsers
category.why: It runs on staff computers, phones or browsers.
category.doThis: Install the latest updates on every device, and turn on automatic updates.

summary: Google Pixel devices contain an improper authorization vulnerability in the cellular modem. A logic error may allow an attacker to bypass permission checks and escalate privileges.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Sep 19, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.

evidence.title: CISA Vulnrichment marks CVE-2026-58704 as actively exploited
